_comment: Declarative model registry for model.gateway. The gateway resolves a requested model (by -Model id, -Tier alias, or the default) against `models`, and runs it if `wired` and its type/engine are supported (MVP: type=llm via engine=llama-server). Non-wired / non-LLM entries are DECLARED so later modules can wire them without rediscovering the machine. Paths point at PORTABLE STAGED COPIES under _pending-model-storage (decoupled from the obsolete source folders). To swap which model a tier uses, change `tiers`/`defaults` below — no code change.

engines._comment: Staged, verified to run standalone (health + chat) 2026-07-24. Depends on a system CUDA runtime (not on the source folder). If torn down, restage from F:\Qwen3.5-27B\llama.cpp\build\bin.

models.name: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
models.notes: Fastest; smoke tests / trivial labeling. Fully GPU-offloaded on the RTX 2080 Ti.

models.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
models.notes: Default weak tier: bulk classification/labeling/extraction. Fully GPU-offloaded.

models.name: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct
models.notes: Mid tier: harder labeling; still fully GPU-offloaded.

models.name: Qwen3.5-27B
models.notes: Strong tier: review/adjudication (Module 9). ~16 GB Q4 > 11 GB VRAM, so PARTIAL GPU offload. Tuned by Module 9 (2026-07-24): swept gpu_layers {20,28,36} on an idle GPU — all loaded (no OOM), throughput monotonic 1.43/1.67/1.93 tok/s; raised 28 -> 32 (strictly fewer layers than the 36 that fit, so it fits with headroom for desktop display VRAM). Cold first load ~90s (16 GB read from F:), warm ~7-9s (OS cache); callers should pass a longer load timeout for a cold strong load (review.processor -LoadTimeoutSec). Still slow (~2 tok/s) — reserve for the hardest items.

models.name: Whisper base.en (ggml)
models.notes: Consumed by speech.stt (Module 11), which reads this entry's path + engine_candidates directly. Still wired:false for model.gateway on purpose — the gateway MVP runs type=llm only, so it correctly returns model_not_wired for STT. whisper.cpp CLI (CUDA + CPU builds) verified 2026-07-24 (m11-probe-001/002); live base.en transcription passed 27/27 via the executor (m11-test-001).

models.name: Qwen3-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz
models.notes: DECLARED only. Shared speech tokenizer used by the Qwen3-TTS voices (also bundled inside each voice's speech_tokenizer/ — see REVIEW_QUEUE re: triplication). Wire in Module 12 (speech.tts).

models.name: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice
models.notes: Consumed by speech.tts (Module 11's sibling, Module 12), which reads this entry's path + engine_env directly. Still wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway MVP runs type=llm only). Default weak TTS voice. Runs under the speech venv (torch 2.11+cu128, transformers 4.57.3, qwen_tts). Verified 2026-07-24 (m12-probe-002 live synthesis; m12-test-001 27→25/25). English speakers Ryan/Aiden; 24 kHz mono output.

models.name: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice
models.notes: Consumed by speech.tts (Module 12) as the strong tier (-Tier strong / -Model tts.strong.qwen3-1p7b). Still wired:false for model.gateway (type=llm only). Stronger TTS voice; runs under the speech venv. Slower per-call load (3.8 GB); reserve for higher-quality synthesis.

models.name: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B
models.notes: DECLARED only. Discovered under an ACE-Step music suite; copied for portability. Wire in Module 23 (artifact.search). Could also run via llama.cpp llama-server --embedding if converted to GGUF.

models.name: Windows.Media.Ocr (system)
models.notes: Consumed by ocr.layout (Module 14), which runs Windows.Media.Ocr in a Windows PowerShell 5.1 worker (pwsh 7 cannot load the WinRT projection — m14-probe-001) and reads its meta file. System WinRT engine: no model file, no GPU, no network; en-US recognizer present; MaxImageDimension=10000. wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway runs type=llm only). Verified live 2026-07-25 (m14-probe-001 words+boxes+lines+angle ~74 ms; m14-test-001).

models.name: Tesseract OCR
models.notes: DECLARED only. Installed (found by m14-probe-001). A future ocr.layout engine: calibrated per-word confidence + hOCR/TSV boxes + multi-language. Not wired in the Module 14 MVP (only windows.media.ocr).

models.name: YOLOX-Nano (COCO-80)
models.notes: Consumed by detect.objects (Module 16), which runs the ONNX model via onnxruntime in a Python worker (detect_worker.py) under this engine_env (the system python; onnxruntime-gpu 1.17.1) and reads its meta file. Default CPU execution provider -> no GPU/port binding, so detect.objects is parallel_safe. wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway runs type=llm only). Staged to F: + verified live 2026-07-25 (m16-probe-001: CPU provider load + dog/car/bicycle on the committed fixture, identical to the cloud box). YOLOX letterbox-416 preproc, strides {8,16,32}, obj*cls score, class-aware NMS; real per-detection confidence. Apache-2.0 (Megvii YOLOX).

models.name: YOLOX-Tiny (COCO-80)
models.notes: Second detector tier (-Tier tiny). Same YOLOX topology/decode as nano but more accurate (~5M params). Apache-2.0 (Megvii YOLOX). A drop-in for detect.objects with no code change; if the F: file is absent, detect.objects returns a clean model_file_not_found.

models.name: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct (GGUF)
models.notes: Consumed by image.interpret (Module 17), which runs this GGUF + its mmproj projector via the staged llama.cpp llama-server (b8661, multimodal build) - launch -m <path> --mmproj <mmproj> -c 8192 -ngl 99, then POST /v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI-style image_url base64 data URI. Fully GPU-offloaded on the RTX 2080 Ti (~3.1 GB weights + image tokens, ~111 tok/s). wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway runs type=llm only; image.interpret reads this entry itself, decoupled from the wired gate like ocr.layout/detect.objects). Downloaded from ggml-org/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-GGUF and staged to F: + load-and-caption verified live 2026-07-25 (m17-probe-002/003). Apache-2.0 (Alibaba Qwen). A 7B tier and a transformers-venv backend are documented follow-ons.
